I shall surely conquer all the Pandavas gathered today. 58
Duryodhana said:
I will do all this just as you think, O Karna. The chariots with quivers will surely follow you, O son of a charioteer. 59
May they carry carts filled with arrows with eagle-feathered shafts.

<column-break/>

We and all the kings will follow you, O Karna. 60
Sanjaya said:
Having said this, O great king, your valorous son, the king, approached the King of the Madras <note>Shalya</note> and spoke these words. 61

->Thus ends the twenty-second chapter in the Karna Parva of the glorious Mahabharata. 22<-

---

## 23

Sanjaya said:
Your son, O great king, approached the King of the Madras with humility and spoke these words out of affection. 1
O truth-vowed, highly fortunate one, you who increase the sorrow of your enemies.

<summary>Duryodhana asks Karna to prepare for battle, confirming that the army will follow him, and subsequently approaches King Shalya with humility to solicit his support.</summary>
